title: Laddu and the Runaway Kite
moral: When we share, our happiness grows bigger.
description: Laddu gets a shiny new red kite and doesn't want to share it with Chintu. But when the wind carries the kite into the tallest tree, Chintu's wobbly plan and one hungry goat save the day! Count to three with Laddu, Chintu, Golu and Dadaji in this funny animated story about sharing for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: One sunny morning, Laddu puffed and panted up Masti Hill with a brand-new red kite!
The kite had a long tail with little blue bows. Let's count them together! One... two... three!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Three bows! Arre wah! Now... is it lunch time yet?

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Wow, Laddu! Can I have a turn, please?

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: No way! It's MY kite. I'm flying it all by myself.
Chintu's glasses slid down his nose. Uh-oh. That wasn't very kind, was it?

narration.text: Suddenly, WHOOSH! A big wind tugged the string right out of Laddu's hands.
The kite flew over the stream and got stuck at the very top of the tallest tree.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Oh no! My kite! Don't worry, I'll just jump and get it!
Boing! Too low. Boing! Still too low. Ka-BONK! Laddu bumped right into the tree trunk!
How many times did Laddu jump? Can you count?
Three times! And now he's all wibble-wobbly!

narration.text: Then Chintu came running, his glasses bouncing.

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! I'll climb on your shoulders, Laddu! It's a plan... a slightly wobbly plan!
Wibble, wobble, CRASH! The two friends tumbled into a giggly heap.
Just then, Golu the goat trotted up and gave the tree a mighty head-butt!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
Down floated the red kite, right into Laddu's arms. And Golu tried to eat the tail!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Thank you, Chintu! Sorry I didn't share. Let's fly it together!

narration.text: That evening, the two friends took turns flying the red kite on Masti Hill.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Look at you two! A happy thing grows bigger when we share it.
Let's remember! How many blue bows were on the kite?

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Three! One, two, three! Sharing is the best... and so are jalebis!
And the little red kite flew higher than ever before.
